data.question: Persentase penduduk miskin di Gorontalo sekarang berapa?

value.raw_question: Persentase penduduk miskin di Gorontalo sekarang berapa?

value.sql:
SELECT 
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah, 
    SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai 
FROM 
    nilai_indikator 
JOIN 
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode 
WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator 
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode 
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY 
    provinsi.nama 
ORDER BY 
    nilai DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, AVG(nilai_indikator.nilai) * 100 / SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) OVER() AS persentase_penduduk_miskin
FROM nilai_indikator
JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.kode, provinsi.nama
ORDER BY persentase_penduduk_miskin DESC;

SELECT T1.wilayah AS wilayah, T1.periode AS periode, AVG(T2.nilai) AS nilai FROM provinsi AS T1 INNER JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator AND T2.periode = :periode AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0) GROUP BY T1.wilayah, T1.periode

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, periode, AVG(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM provinsi
JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama, periode;

SELECT
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    MAX(CASE WHEN nilai_indikator.periode = :periode THEN nilai_indikator.nilai END) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi) AS persentase
FROM
    provinsi
JOIN
    nilai_indikator
ON
    provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
    provinsi.kode
ORDER BY
    persentase DESC
LIMIT 1

value.sql:
SELECT
  provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
  AVG(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM
  provinsi
JOIN
  nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
JOIN
  kamus_istilah ON kamus_istilah.istilah = 'penduduk_miskin'
WHERE
  nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = '001'
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = '2026-03'
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN ('01')
GROUP BY
  provinsi.nama;

SELECT
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    periode,
    SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nilai_indikator) * 100 AS persentase_miskin
FROM
    provinsi
JOIN
    nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
    provinsi.kode, periode
ORDER BY
    nilai_indikator.nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.wilayah, T1.periode, SUM(T2.nilai) / COUNT(*) AS persentase_penduduk_miskin
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND T2.periode = :periode
AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY T1.wilayah, T1.periode;
